The '''Battle of Arda''' was a conflict between the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]] in the [[Arda system/Legends|Arda system]].

==Background==
Following the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Battle of Nam Chorios|victory]] against [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tol Getelles|Getelles]] of the [[Antemeridian sector/Legends|Antemeridian sector]], the New Republic [[Invasion of the Antemeridian sector|pushed]] through the neutral [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Borderland Regions]] toward the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]], border of the [[Imperial Space]]. The Moffs of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], fearing the shift of power in the region, ordered [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] to move his forces across the Hydian Way.<ref name="TEA" /> Torn away from his [[Campaign against Adumar|campaign]] against the planet [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]], Pellaeon brought his forces into the fight against the New Republic.<ref name="TEC" /> The Imperial forces defeated the New Republic in the [[Lucazec system/Legends|Lucazec]] and [[Barison system/Legends|Barison systems]] and continued their progression.<ref name="TEA" />

==The battle==
In the [[Arda system/Legends|Arda system]], the Imperial forces once again engaged New Republic forces and inflicted them substantial casualties but this time they were not able to secure a victory. They were forced to retreat to the [[Celanon system/Legends|Celanon system]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Aftermath==
After the Imperial defeat at Arda and [[Battle of Quell|another]] in the [[Quell system/Legends|Quell system]], the New Republic launched a [[Battle of Celanon|counterattack]] at [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]] where Admiral Pellaeon's defeat ended the campaign.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
This battle makes its unique appearance in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''. The battle is only illustrated on the galactic map of the conflict.
